name: answer_back_to_the_agent
title: Tasks · an agent made on call, and the answer to its question goes back to it

steps.say: keep a list of deals: the firm's name and the asking price
steps.reply:
I've set up a **Deal list** in a new **Deals** module. Each deal has two fields: **Firm name** and **Asking price**. The list is empty for now.

The asking price is a plain number with no currency attached. If your deals are in more than one currency, I can add a currency field.

To add a deal, tell me the firm and the price, for example "Acme Corp, asking 4.5m".
I added **Midwest HVAC** to your deal list with an asking price of **900,000**. I read "900k" as 900,000. You didn't give a currency, so none is recorded. It's the only deal on the list so far.

steps.say: make an agent called Deal Analyst that, when given a task about a deal, works it out from the deal's row, saves what it found on the row with its source, and asks me for anything the row doesn't have
steps.reply:
I've set up **Deal Analyst** in your Deals module. It has no schedule. It works only when you give it a task about a deal and start it, or when you mention it with @.

For each task it will:
1. **Read the deal's row first.** It starts from what the row already holds, such as Midwest HVAC's asking price of 900,000.
2. **Work out the answer.** It looks up public facts and keeps the link to each one. When it calculates something from the row, it shows the math. When something can't be known, it marks the value as an estimate and says what it assumed.

steps.say: add a task on Midwest HVAC to ask the broker for 3 years of P&L, give it to the Deal Analyst and start it
steps.reply:
I added the task **Ask the broker for 3 years of P&L** to Midwest HVAC's row in your Deal list, gave it to the **Deal Analyst** and started it. The analyst will begin within about half a minute, and you can follow its progress on the task's page.

The row only holds the firm's name and the asking price. It doesn't say who the broker is or how to reach them, so the Deal Analyst will probably ask you for that. Nothing will be sent to the broker until you approve it.
